newsitem.title: UK: British Borneo plunges on drilling report.
newsitem.headline: British Borneo plunges on drilling report.

text.p: Shares in British-Borneo Petroleum Syndicate Plc dived 140p to 14 stg by 0855 GMT on Friday after bearish news from its Gulf of Mexico Green Canyon exploration well, dealers said.
The shares hit a low of 13.55 stg immediately after the news.
"The oil is extremely heavy and basically won't flow," said one specialist salesman.
"People had priced in a good 90p upside based on good news so this is a rational move for the shares," he said.

British Borneo said it had recovered abnormal oil samples of very heavy 8.6 degrees API at an exploration well in block Green Canyon 37. API is a measure of oil gravity. The lower the gravity the heavier the oil. Heavy oil is generally cheaper than light oil.
British-Borneo said the result was "very much anomalous", pointing to 20 to 30 degree API oil finds in nearby fields such as Morpeth, Lobster, Manta Ray and Arnold.
